tools.name: pipedrive_list_deals
tools.description: List deals, optionally filtered by filter/owner/person/org/pipeline/stage/status and sorted. Pipedrive REST: GET /api/v2/deals.

tools.name: pipedrive_get_deal
tools.description: Get a single deal by its id. Pipedrive REST: GET /api/v2/deals/{id}.

tools.name: pipedrive_search_deals
tools.description: Search deals by term across selected fields. Pipedrive REST: GET /api/v2/deals/search.

tools.name: pipedrive_list_persons
tools.description: List persons (contacts), optionally filtered by filter/owner/org and sorted. Pipedrive REST: GET /api/v2/persons.

tools.name: pipedrive_get_person
tools.description: Get a single person (contact) by its id. Pipedrive REST: GET /api/v2/persons/{id}.

tools.name: pipedrive_search_persons
tools.description: Search persons (contacts) by term across selected fields. Pipedrive REST: GET /api/v2/persons/search.

tools.name: pipedrive_list_organizations
tools.description: List organizations, optionally filtered by filter/owner and sorted. Pipedrive REST: GET /api/v2/organizations.

tools.name: pipedrive_get_organization
tools.description: Get a single organization by its id. Pipedrive REST: GET /api/v2/organizations/{id}.

tools.name: pipedrive_search_organizations
tools.description: Search organizations by term across selected fields. Pipedrive REST: GET /api/v2/organizations/search.

tools.name: pipedrive_list_activities
tools.description: List activities (tasks/events), optionally filtered by filter/owner/deal/person/org/done/updated_since. Pipedrive REST: GET /api/v2/activities.

tools.name: pipedrive_list_pipelines
tools.description: List all pipelines. Pipedrive REST: GET /api/v2/pipelines.

tools.name: pipedrive_list_stages
tools.description: List stages, optionally restricted to a single pipeline. Pipedrive REST: GET /api/v2/stages.

tools.name: pipedrive_search_items
tools.description: Global search across multiple item types (deals, persons, organizations, products, leads, files, etc.). Pipedrive REST: GET /api/v2/itemSearch.

tools.name: pipedrive_get_current_user
tools.description: Get the authenticated user's profile (name, email, company, locale, timezone). Pipedrive REST: GET /api/v1/users/me.

tools.name: pipedrive_list_notes
tools.description: List notes, optionally filtered by user/deal/person/org/lead. Uses v1 (v2 has no notes endpoint) with start+limit pagination. Pipedrive REST: GET /api/v1/notes.

tools.name: pipedrive_create_deal
tools.description: Create a new deal. `title` is required; link it to a person/org/pipeline/stage/owner as needed. Pipedrive REST: POST /api/v2/deals.

tools.name: pipedrive_create_person
tools.description: Create a new person (contact). `name` is required; `email`/`phone` are convenience strings mapped to Pipedrive's structured emails/phones arrays. Pipedrive REST: POST /api/v2/persons.

tools.name: pipedrive_create_activity
tools.description: Create a new activity (task/event). `subject` is required; link it to a deal/person/org and set type/date/time as needed. Pipedrive REST: POST /api/v2/activities.

tools.name: pipedrive_add_note
tools.description: Add a note, linked to at least one of a deal/person/organization/lead. `content` is required (HTML or plain text). Uses v1 (v2 has no notes endpoint). Pipedrive REST: POST /api/v1/notes.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pipedrive_get_current_user · Private data: pipedrive_list_persons, pipedrive_get_person, pipedrive_search_persons, pipedrive_search_items, pipedrive_create_person · Public sink: pipedrive_get_current_user, pipedrive_create_deal, pipedrive_create_person, pipedrive_create_activity, pipedrive_add_note.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pipedrive_get_current_user · Private data: pipedrive_list_persons, pipedrive_get_person, pipedrive_search_persons, pipedrive_search_items, pipedrive_create_person · Public sink: pipedrive_get_current_user, pipedrive_create_deal, pipedrive_create_person, pipedrive_create_activity, pipedrive_add_note

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
